facts.quote: E.1 Evaluation Setup Table 6 lists the setup of every benchmark. We sample Qwen-3.8-27B at temperature 1.0 with top-p 0.95, top-k 20, min-p 0 and no presence penalty, and GLM-5.3-Flash at temperature 1.0 with top-p 0.95, as their model cards recommend. On RULER, both models decode greedily with reasoning disabled. On every benchmark with reasoning, at most 4.6% of the replies reach the output cap of 163,840 tokens for any model and method.
